sources.entry: ResignTool - This is an app for macOS that can (re)sign apps and bundle them into ipa files that are ready to be installed on an iOS device.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app that re-signs iOS .ipa files and repackages them so they can be installed on an iOS device, with optional bundle identifier and display name changes.
use_cases: Re-signing an iOS .ipa with your own certificate and provisioning profile
Installing the same iOS app twice on one iPhone by changing its bundle identifier
Packaging an app with bundled .framework or .dylib files for installation
Sideloading an iOS app from a Mac
Changing an app's display name before installing
how_to_run: Create a new project in Xcode to obtain a provisioning profile and signing certificate
Select the input .ipa file, signing certificate, and provisioning profile
Optionally set a new application ID and/or display name
Run the signing process to produce an installable .ipa
notable: Not restricted by the applicationIdentifier in the provisioning profile
Can change BundleIdentifier to install multiple copies of the same app
Bundles re-signed output into ipa files ready for iOS installation
caveats: Cloned apps may not receive push notifications
Does not support some binary and bundle files such as .appex
